answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the juniper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
